_comment: Secrets (TCLI_AUTH_TOKEN, NEXUSMODS_API_KEY) live in .env, which is gitignored.
The version is NOT stored here - the repo-root VERSION file is the single source of truth.

_idNamespaceWarning: CRITICAL: Nexus v1 and v3 use DIFFERENT id namespaces, and mixing them fails with a
misleading 403 'You do not have permission to upload files to this mod'.
The Upload API is v3, so the ids below MUST be v3 ids - not the ones the v1 API returns
and not the number in the mod page URL.
nexus._pageModIdComment: Game-scoped id - the number in the mod page URL, https://www.nexusmods.com/valheim/mods/3349. Used only for building links, never for API calls.
nexus._modIdComment: v3 internal mod id, used for the changelog endpoint. Rediscover with: GET https://api.nexusmods.com/v3/games/valheim/mods/3349 -> data.id
nexus._fileIdComment: v3 mod_file id that new versions are attached to. Rediscover with: GET https://api.nexusmods.com/v3/mods/15749645077781/files -> data.mod_files[].id. NOTE: the v1 file ids (20598/20599) are versions of this single v3 mod_file, not separate files.
nexus._uploadActionComment: Pinned tag of Nexus-Mods/upload-action. This is still a beta API surface - bump deliberately, not automatically.
